description: Whether the Retraction Watch database lists the given DOI as retracted, from the dated export CiteStamp joins weekly. Use when a user asks whether a paper has been retracted or carries a retraction notice. Not listed means not in that export; the publisher record is not checked.

identifier.description: DOI in any common form (10.x/y, doi:10.x/y or a doi.org URL)

name: retraction_listing
title: Retraction listing
